svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: What verification covers, and what it does not
svg.desc: Two columns. The left column, code, is covered by make verify: every example is re-run, printed outputs are re-captured and diffed against the page, and the whole suite runs nightly in CI. Its status line reads: fails loudly. The right column, claims, has nothing that runs them, and lists the four serious defects the project has had so far: a CI check that went green having verified nothing; contributor rules that had quietly gone stale; a README status table advertising shipped work as pending; and a published evaluation finding that had to be retracted, although the repository had recorded the correction three days earlier. Its status line reads: fails silently. The heading says every serious defect so far got past a green build. Beneath both, two fixes are listed: re-read the governing documents at every milestone, and recompute the evaluation's key numbers from committed artifacts so the build fails if they drift.
svg.text: THE HALF THAT VERIFICATION DOESN'T COVER
Every serious defect so far got past a green build.

g.text: The whole suite runs nightly in CI
1 A CI check green, having verified nothing
3 A status table calling shipped work pending
4 A published finding, retracted — the fix
was already in the repo, unread
→ Re-read the governing documents against reality at every milestone
→ Recompute the evaluation's key numbers from committed artifacts, so the build fails if they drift
